notes.title: We live in the shadows
notes.content:
[h2][b]Update [/b][/h2][p][b]Main changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Big graphical update[/p][/*][*][p]Added languages: Turkish, French, Portuguese and Italian[/p][/*][*][p]Story mode added (about 45 hours long)[/p][/*][*][p]Added 91 achievements[/p][/*][*][p]God powers in spectator mode[/p][/*][*][p]The bot factions have some diplomacy options[/p][/*][*][p]Music[/p][/*][/list][h2]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538044/689344bd7b92c3b898d2843465a0a3056628e805.png"][/img][/h2][h2]Blog[/h2][p]From the start, I’ve been ramping up towards October’s Next Fest. I was confident and ahead of schedule, but then I changed the graphics at the last minute and now I’ll have to rework the store page in full panic… it always ends in panic.[/p][p]You might know that Steam hides all new games until they reach a certain number of wishlists and/or sales. This is so the 50,000 trash games released each year won’t flood the market.
[b]DSS 2[/b] has reached 8,000 wishlists and even entered “Popular Upcoming” on Steam. I’m expecting to release in November with around 14,000 wishlists. I finally registered my company two weeks ago - something I’d been putting off because of the hard-hitting taxes in Sweden.[/p][p]I’ve projected that I’ll be able to pay myself about €1,500 a month from the game. That’s low compared to my old job (€4,000/month), but I’m pretty good at living on almost nothing. I just have to pray to Freya to keep my computer alive.
So now I’m officially a game developer - hurray :)[/p][p]Now when I can use the government child day care. I have started to practice streaming some playtesting. I’m not great at talking in front of a camera, but hopefully will get better.  
[/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/@vikingfabian/streams"]https://www.youtube.com/@vikingfabian/streams[/url][/p][p]

notes.title: Multiplayer, Controller Support, and a Canceled Story
notes.content:
[b]Main Update Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Local split-screen multiplayer
[*]In-game controller support (Steam Input must be turned off)
[*]Extended demo to 90 minutes
[*]Lots of small improvements
[/list]

[b]Development Blog[/b]
Last week I attended two gaming expos: the Nordic Game Festival and Creative Coast. I went there hoping to network and get media coverage. It was a lot of fun, but honestly, a total waste of time.

I received many complaints about the demo length — it’s nice that you like it so much! But still, it’s a bit odd that people don’t realize demos have limits. I extended the demo a bit, but Steam best practices recommend a one-hour limit, and I don’t want to “shit where I eat,” as they say. DSS1 is still free and has no limits.

The story is canceled. I asked around, and there was very little interest in it, so I’ll focus that energy on other features.

[i]My backpack hack at Nordic Game[/i]
